name: Them
source:
There's an alien man in your house! Well, you're an alien too, so that's no biggie...but what is he doing here?

"They brought me here," he says. "You're supposed to be my mate, huh?"

Huh? What in the world is he talking about? More importantly, who are they?

[from [url=https://poison-apple-tales.itch.io/them]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你家里出现了一个外星男人！不过，你也是外星人，所以这没什么大不了……但他为什么会在这里？

“他们把我带到这里的。”他如此说道，“你应该是我的伴侣，对吧？”

什么？他到底在说什么？更重要的是，他们是谁？

（来源：[url=https://poison-apple-tales.itch.io/them]itch.io[/url]）
